import fs from 'node:fs';
import readline from 'node:readline';
const LOG = new URL('./stub.log.jsonl', import.meta.url);
const MODE = process.env.STUB_MODE || 'deny';
const log = (o) => fs.appendFileSync(LOG, JSON.stringify(o) + '\n');
const send = (o) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(o) + '\n');
readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin }).on('line', (line) => {
  let m; try { m = JSON.parse(line); } catch { return; }
  log({ dir: 'in', msg: m });
  if (m.method === 'initialize') {
    send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: { protocolVersion: m.params?.protocolVersion ?? '2025-06-18', capabilities: { tools: {} }, serverInfo: { name: 'stub', version: '0.0.1' } } });
  } else if (m.method === 'tools/list') {
    send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: { tools: [{ name: 'approve', description: 'permission prompt', inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { tool_name: { type: 'string' }, input: { type: 'object' }, tool_use_id: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['tool_name', 'input'] } }] } });
  } else if (m.method === 'tools/call') {
    const a = m.params.arguments || {};
    const res = MODE === 'allow' ? { behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: a.input } : { behavior: 'deny', message: 'denied by stub' };
    log({ dir: 'out', decision: res });
    send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(res) }] } });
  } else if (m.id !== undefined) {
    send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: {} });
  }
});
